description: Manage Kubernetes from the sidebar — workloads, pods, services and the rest of a namespace, with live logs, supervised port-forwards and an inline preview of what a service serves.
author: Risa Labs

definedPermissions.name: kubernetes.manage
definedPermissions.description: Delete, scale and restart Kubernetes resources, and install, upgrade, roll back or uninstall Helm releases

definedPermissions.name: kubernetes.exec
definedPermissions.description: Open an interactive shell inside a pod — arbitrary command execution in the cluster with that pod's credentials, including reading its mounted Secrets

definedPermissions.name: kubernetes.portforward
definedPermissions.description: Forward a local port to a service or pod in the cluster, making an internal service reachable from this machine over any protocol it speaks

definedPermissions.name: helm.repo
definedPermissions.description: Add or remove Helm chart repositories in the shared ~/.config/helm config, which affects this machine outside BOSS

definedPermissions.name: helm.publish
definedPermissions.description: Push packaged Helm charts to an OCI registry
